saudi-arabia.title: Flag of Saudi Arabia

colors.note: Represents Islam, believed to be the Prophet's favourite colour
Represents the sword of justice and the shahada inscription

desc:
- A green field bearing the shahada (Islamic creed) in white Arabic script with a horizontal sword below
- Because it bears the shahada, the flag is never flown at half-mast
- **Construction:** a green field bearing the Shahada (Islamic creed) in white Thuluth calligraphy above a white horizontal sword (pointing left)
- The text and sword are centred
- Because of the sacred inscription, the flag is never flown at half-mast and is manufactured with identical obverse and reverse
trivia:
- The Shahada (Islamic declaration of faith) is written in white above the sword
- The sword represents the strength and sovereignty of the nation
- The green colour represents Islam; the flag has never been lowered to half-mast out of respect
